FillModel.description:
The fill model a run uses.

Named rather than free-form so a result can state exactly how it was filled; an unrecognised model would make results incomparable.

oneOf.description: Fill at the bar's open, next open, or a fraction of the bar's range.
Fill only when the bar trades through the order price.
Top-of-book matching against quote/trade ticks (ADR 0030). The run needs a tick source; a run whose data source supplies bars only is refused with `l2_requires_ticks`.
No fills; used to test the strategy's signal path alone.

InstrumentId.description: A trading instrument, combining a symbol and its exchange.

OrderRateLimit.description: At most `max_orders` approved orders in any `window_ms` of event time.

max_orders.description: Maximum approved orders per window; must be `>= 1`.

window_ms.description: Window length in milliseconds of event time; must be `>= 1`.

ParameterSpec.description: A parameter declaration with a default value and optional sweep range (E4-S2).

RiskLimits.description: Per-run risk limits. `None` means the rule is off; the default has no limits.

max_notional.description: Per-order notional ceiling in major units of the account currency. `None` = no notional rule; `Some` must be finite and `> 0`.

max_participation.description: Maximum order quantity as a fraction of ADV. `None` = no participation rule; `Some` must be in `(0, 1]`.

order_rate.description: Orders-per-window ceiling in event time. `None` = no rate rule.

price_collar_bps.description: Market-order price collar in basis points (ADR 0018 addendum): a market order (and the market leg of a stop) is refused when its expected execution price deviates from the reference price by more than this. `None` = no collar; `Some` must be `>= 1`.

stale_after_ms.description: Maximum quote/feed age in milliseconds before an order is refused. `None` = no feed staleness rule; `Some` must be `>= 1`.
